annotations.title: Turn test payments on or off

description: Turns Stripe test mode on (default) or off for the app's pre. On: testers pay with Stripe test cards, nothing is charged, and test purchases never count in pro. Off: purchases in pre charge real money. Waits in the app's queue until neblla_promote "save". More: neblla_get_llms tools/pre_stripe_test

appId.description: The app's public ID, from neblla_list_apps.

on.description: true: test mode; false: real charges.
